items.headline: BlackRock, Inc. Files Disclosure of Voting Rights in ICG PLC
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an acquisition or disposal of voting rights in ICG PLC, a UK-based issuer, with the threshold crossed on November 13, 2026.

items.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Generation Life Launches ConfidencePlus Annuity with BlackRock Alliance
items.summary: Generation Life has introduced an investment-linked lifetime annuity product, ConfidencePlus, developed in partnership with BlackRock.

items.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

items.headline: Microsoft Launches AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced an AI Transparency Initiative aimed at establishing common standards for security, governance, and transparency in artificial intelligence models.

items.headline: Rockwell Automation Launches GPU-Enabled Industrial Computing with NVIDIA
items.summary: Rockwell Automation has introduced new industrial computing solutions powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing to enhance edge AI capabilities.

items.headline: Amazon Expands Grocery Delivery to Include Prepared Meals
items.summary: Amazon has added ready-to-eat and heat-and-eat meal options to its same-day grocery delivery and Amazon Now services.

items.headline: BlackRock Designated as Critical Third Party for UK Financial Sector
items.summary: The UK government has designated BlackRock as a critical third party for the financial sector, subjecting the firm to increased regulatory oversight.

items.headline: Microsoft Commences Ignite 2026 Conference
items.summary: Microsoft has launched its annual Ignite conference in San Francisco, utilizing Haivision's video ecosystem to support global live event production.

items.headline: Mizuho Initiates BlackRock at Outperform With $1,450 Price Target
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage of BlackRock, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $1,450.

items.headline: NVIDIA Issues Warning to Chip Buyers Regarding US Export Compliance
items.summary: NVIDIA has cautioned customers about potential US legal risks associated with providing remote access to advanced chips for Chinese firms.

items.headline: Microsoft Expands Use of Haivision Live Video Ecosystem
items.summary: Microsoft has selected Haivision's video transport and control solutions to support the production of over 600 global events annually.

items.headline: BlackRock Participates in Bajaj Finance Private Share Offering
items.summary: BlackRock, alongside other institutional investors, participated in a $1.2 billion private share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: BlackRock Discloses Voting Rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG

items.headline: Adagene and City of Hope Launch Phase 1 Clinical Trial for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Combination Therapy
items.summary: Adagene Inc. and City of Hope have initiated a Phase 1 clinical trial to evaluate a new combination therapy for patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.

items.headline: Waterdrop Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on December 2, 2026
items.summary: Waterdrop Inc. announced it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before U.S. markets open on December 2, 2026.

items.headline: Cisco Systems Reports Multiple Insider Stock Sales
items.summary: Several insiders at Cisco Systems, Inc. executed stock sales on November 17, 2026, as disclosed in recent SEC filings.

items.headline: HomesToLife Completes Secondary Listing on the Singapore Exchange and Share Placement
items.summary: HomesToLife Ltd has finalized its secondary listing on the Main Board of the Singapore Exchange and completed a share placement raising approximately S$8.6 million.

items.headline: Burning Rock Announces 2026 Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Burning Rock Biotech Limited has scheduled its 2026 annual general meeting for December 22, 2026, in Shanghai.

items.headline: Huize Holding Limited Announces Select Operating Metrics for the First Nine Months of 2026
items.summary: Huize Holding Limited reported growth in key operating metrics, including gross written premiums and customer acquisition, for the first nine months of 2026.

items.headline: Verizon Mobile Service Experiences Outage
items.summary: Verizon mobile service experienced a widespread outage affecting thousands of customers across the United States.

items.headline: Disney to Launch Unified Disney+ and Hulu Experience in December 2026
items.summary: Disney announced that bundle subscribers will receive a fully unified streaming experience on the Disney+ app starting in December 2026.

items.headline: BingEx Limited to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 24, 2026
items.summary: BingEx Limited has scheduled the release of its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026 for November 24, 2026, before the U.S. market opens.

items.headline: CTW Announces Participation in December 2026 Investment Conferences
items.summary: CTW management and investor relations teams will participate in the iAccess Alpha Virtual Best Ideas Winter Investment Conference in December 2026.

items.headline: BNY CEO to Speak at Goldman Sachs Financial Services Conference
items.summary: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation announced that CEO Robin Vince will participate in a discussion at the Goldman Sachs Financial Services Conference on December 9, 2026.

items.headline: Erasca and Bristol Myers Squibb Partner to Test ERAS-0015 with Navlimetostat in Pancreatic Cancer Trial
items.summary: Erasca and Bristol Myers Squibb have entered a clinical collaboration to evaluate the combination of Erasca's ERAS-0015 and BMS's navlimetostat in a Phase 1/2 trial for pancreatic cancer.

items.headline: Capital One Securities Acts as Lead Structuring Agent for BHG Financial ABS Transaction
items.summary: Capital One Securities, Inc. served as the Lead Structuring Agent and Joint Bookrunner for BHG Financial's $495 million asset-backed securities transaction, BHG 2026-3CON.

items.headline: PepsiCo Expands DRIPS by Pepsi® Platform with New Syrup Lineup and Concentrated Bases
items.summary: PepsiCo is expanding its crafted beverage platform, DRIPS by Pepsi®, with the launch of proprietary Signature Mixes and concentrated bases designed for menu versatility.

items.headline: Netflix Partners with Wonder for Branded Restaurant Concept
items.summary: Netflix has partnered with Wonder to launch a branded restaurant concept featuring menu items inspired by its films and series.

items.headline: Victory Capital Shareholders Approve First Eagle Acquisition

items.headline: Torex Resources Celebrates Listing on the New York Stock Exchange

items.headline: The Campbell's Company Declares Quarterly Dividend

items.headline: APi Group Launches $550.3 Million Senior Notes Offering
items.summary: APi Group Corporation has announced the launch of a $550.3 million senior notes offering.

items.headline: Incyte Corporation Insider Sells Shares Worth $1.29 Million
items.summary: An Incyte Corporation insider sold company shares valued at approximately $1.29 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Third Point LLC Reduces Stake in Hut 8 Corp.
items.summary: Investment firm Third Point LLC has disclosed a reduction in its shareholding of Hut 8 Corp. by approximately 6.9%, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: RingCentral Receives Two Industry Awards for AI-Powered Solutions
items.summary: RingCentral, Inc. announced that its AI Receptionist (AIR) won "Best New Technology Solution" at the 2026 ICMI Contact Center Expo, and the company was named "Best Integrated UC Solution" by UC Today.
